name: STAR Geometry — three-dimensional vector operations
summary: Dot, cross and triple product, length, distance, unit vector, accurate angle between directions, projection and rejection of three-dimensional vectors; within 6e-16 of SPICE and ERFA and 8e-15 of NumPy on 600 triples of vectors, nearly parallel pairs included; malformed vectors and zero directions refused.
reference: definitions of the vector products (any text of vector algebra); exact cases by hand: i x j = k, |(3, 4, 0)| = 5, angle((1, 0, 0), (1, 1, 0)) = 45 deg
reference_observed: (0.0, 0.0, 1.0), 5.0, 45.0: exact to rounding (the angle within 1e-13 deg)

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-03: dot(), cross(), norm(), distance(), triple(), unit(), angle_deg(), project(), reject()
review.G-04: the caller's units; angles in degrees; vectors as three-element lists or tuples
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input and for the zero vector where a direction is needed; the range is limited so that no product overflows
